description: This file defines the SubPanelRowCounter class used for counting rows in subpanels within the SuiteCRM application, including methods for generating count queries and handling subpanel data.

classes.name: SubPanelRowCounter
classes.description: A class for counting subpanel rows in SuiteCRM, handling relationship queries and generating count SQL statements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the focus object.

methods.name: getSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a specified subpanel, with error handling.

methods.name: doGetSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Recursively counts rows in subpanel collections or returns count for a single subpanel.

methods.name: getSingleSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to count rows in a subpanel.

methods.name: makeSubPanelRowCountQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query to count subpanel rows based on relationship data.

methods.name: makeFunctionCountQuery
methods.description: Creates a count query from a function-based relationship.

methods.name: selectQueryToCountQuery
methods.description: Converts a SELECT SQL query into a COUNT query.
